title: Bagamoyo: History on the Swahili Coast
excerpt: Bagamoyo, north of Dar es Salaam, was once an important trading town. Its history includes the caravan trade, slavery and colonial rule.
body:
## History

Bagamoyo was an end point of caravan routes from the interior in the 19th century. Ivory and enslaved people passed through. It later became the first capital of German East Africa.

## What to see

- Old stone buildings and the German boma.
- The Catholic mission and museum.
- The Kaole ruins, from the 13th century, with mosques and tombs.
- The fish market and the dhow harbour.

## The name

According to one interpretation, Bagamoyo means "lay down your heart".

## Getting there

About 1.5 to 2 hours from Dar es Salaam.

Read our [Bagamoyo page](/national-parks/bagamoyo/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
